messages:
Nina R.: quick heads-up — I'm swapping weeks with AJ (covering Mon–Sun) and making a small alert-routing tweak for the upcoming low-traffic weekend. filing here so it's on the oncall radar.

Nina R.: change summary: bump inference-latency-95p threshold from 500ms -> 750ms for the nightly batch window (00:00–06:00 UTC) and route those alerts to #eng-runtime instead of #eng-oncall during that window. intent is to reduce noisy latency alerts caused by scheduled maintenance and large batches.

AJ: thanks—ack. two quick q's:
- will we still page on >1% request_error_rate during the window?
- is there a fallback to page eng-oncall if runtime channel is unacknowledged?

Chris K.: good call to put in thread. answers:
- request_error_rate pages unchanged (still pages to eng-oncall at severity=critical). only the latency metric routing changes.
- yes, we have a 15m escalation policy: if #eng-runtime has no ack, route to eng-oncall and then to pagers. I can paste the policy.

Chris K.: escalation policy snippet:
```yaml
alert_rule: inference-latency-95p-nightly
window: 00:00-06:00 UTC
threshold: 750ms
route: channel: eng-runtime
escalation: - after: 15m -> channel: eng-oncall - after: 30m -> pager: primary
```

AJ: perfect. can we also add a short message to #eng-runtime when the rule flips so people know it's the nightly-tuning change? saves confusion if someone sees the metric spike.

Nina R.: yes I'll add the descriptive note and link to the playbook. putting the change into deploy so infra can audit it.

oncall-bot: Nina R. swapped oncall weeks with AJ. New coverage: AJ Mon 2026-05-04 -> Sun 2026-05-10.

oncall-bot: Scheduled routing change queued: inference-latency-95p-nightly will be applied 2026-05-07T00:00:00Z.

Chris K.: tiny test plan before weekend:
1) create canary alert at 650ms during the window (should route to eng-runtime, NOT page)
2) create a critical error test (request_error_rate high) — should page eng-oncall immediately
3) simulate no acks in eng-runtime to confirm escalation path triggers to pager after 15m

AJ: I'll run step 2 and 3 during handover tonight. Nina, if you can run step 1 after the deploy that'd be great.

Nina R.: done — will also add a note to the handoff doc and drop a link to the alertpolicy in the playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/alerts/inference-latency

AJ: thanks all. no expected customer impact; flagging here so oncall has context. :thumbsup:

Chris K.: noted. ping me if anything weird pops up during the rollout and I'll be around for the initial 2 hours.

Nina R.: closing loop — change scheduled, test plan in place, AJ covering week. thanks!
